notifications.name: Tegami
notifications.author: Ryoku Team
notifications.description: Each notification arrives as a small letter: sender and time above an editorial headline, the app seal beside the message, a quiet row of actions, a vermilion edge for urgent ones and a hairline that drains while it waits.

notifications.name: Yatagarasu
notifications.author: 0xSrcAura
notifications.description: Each notification arrives as a Kasugai dispatch scroll: a dark glass plate with a lit priority edge (LOW cyan, MEDIUM emerald, HIGH amber, CRITICAL rose), the sender's seal, the message in mono, and a burn line along the foot that spends the scroll's remaining life — a critical does not burn; it waits, ember-lit, with ACK REQUIRED until acknowledged. Pictures ride framed in the scroll, long messages unfold in place, the card mirrors for the left column and crowns for the centre, and a sender may speak all four priorities through the x-jurai-priority hint. No crow stands on the card: she roosts at the desktop's corner, and the scrolls are her voice.
